title: Welcome to the new semester
message: Check your dashboard regularly for class updates, campus announcements, and student support information.

title: Keep your student profile up to date
message: Review your contact details in your profile so important Student Hub updates can reach you.

title: Explore upcoming campus events
message: Visit the Events page to browse workshops, student activities, and campus community events.

title: Stay on top of assignment deadlines
message: Check your assignments regularly and plan ahead for upcoming due dates.

title: Share your ideas with Student Hub
message: Use the Feedback page to share suggestions that can help improve campus life.

title: Library study spaces are open
message: Quiet study areas are available throughout the week. Please leave shared spaces tidy for the next students.

title: Review your course timetable
message: Check your timetable for room or schedule changes before heading to class.

title: Student clubs welcome new members
message: Connect with a student club to meet classmates and take part in activities across campus.

title: Workshop registration is open
message: Browse the Events page and register for workshops that support your learning and career goals.

title: Take a wellbeing break
message: Remember to take regular breaks, stay hydrated, and make time for rest during busy study weeks.

title: Keep campus contact details handy
message: Save the Student Hub contact information so you can find support when you need it.

title: Prepare for upcoming assessments
message: Use your assignment list to review upcoming deadlines and organize your study plan.

title: Share feedback on campus activities
message: Your feedback helps the student community plan useful events and improve campus activities.

title: Find upcoming student events
message: New student activities are listed on the Events page. Check back for updates throughout the term.

title: Make use of student support resources
message: Explore the support resources available to students and reach out when you need assistance.
